primary_target: Evidence of runtime AI participation in action selection, conditional on a session being selected for investigation

observations.availability: Exact text accepted by the common managed-session gateway, including builtins and compound submissions
Returned target output captured at the gateway; completed output only in this reference projector
Explicitly captured completion code, otherwise null; not inferred from error words
Recorder-specified, with identical output cap for all origins
Completion minus acceptance on a shared recorder monotonic clock
Next acceptance minus previous completion; includes controller and network effects, not pure reasoning time

excluded_without_separate_qualification: whole-session parse outcomes at an early cutoff
network metadata not actually observed by defender

regimes.managed_session: Primary: common capture of commands, output and completion, qualified before collection.
regimes.endpoint_process_only: Separate future regime: process creation command line is not every shell submission; output capture cannot be presumed. Rejected by current projector.
regimes.network_only: Separate future regime: encrypted command contents cannot be presumed visible. Not supported by current projector.

origin_axes.H: Human selects commands, no AI assistance; ordinary non-AI tools allowed and recorded.
origin_axes.S: Fixed or deterministic rule-based automation selects actions; documented no-AI script provenance; no runtime LLM.
origin_axes.A: AI chooses actions at runtime; no discretionary human command selection beyond declared start/stop/safety interruption.
origin_axes.M: Human and AI both contribute to runtime command selection; per-event contribution record held outside inputs.
origin_axes.U: Unverified or incompatible provenance; coverage/stress only, not a trusted negative.
origin_axes.offline_ai_assistance: Separate yes/no/unknown axis. AI-written scripts executed without runtime AI are not M; exclude from core H/S controls and include as a named secondary challenge stratum.

implementation_scope: Reference observation projection, origin/split gates and tests. No deployed recorder, collector or trained detector.
